rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being preoccupied with material possessions and worldly wealth.

example.english: He is always overly focused on designer brands and wealth; this materialism is exhausting.
example.traditional: 佢成日將名牌同財富睇得太重，呢種物質主義真係令人攰。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 ming4 paai4 tung4 coi4 fu3 tai2 dak1 taai3 zung6 ne1 zung2 mat6 zat1 zyu2 ji6 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 gui6

rows.note: Use this when the materialism specifically involves worship or excessive fixation on money.

example.english: They choose a partner based only on money; it is pure materialism.
example.traditional: 佢擇偶淨係睇錢，完全係拜金主義。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zaak6 ngau5 zing6 hai6 tai2 cin4 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 baai3 gam1 zyu2 ji6

rows.note: Use this for the philosophical doctrine that only physical matter exists.

example.english: Materialism holds that nothing exists independently of matter.
example.traditional: 唯物主義認為，世界上除咗物質，冇其他獨立存在嘅嘢。
example.jyutping: wai4 mat6 zyu2 ji6 jing6 wai4 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 ceoi4 zo2 mat6 zat1 mou5 kei4 taa1 duk6 laap6 cyun4 zoi6 ge3 je5
